The diagram shows the arrangement of carbon atoms in a giant covalent structure.
Which row identifies the substance and describes a use of this substance?
substance
use of substance
A
diamond
It is an electrode because electrons can move.
B
diamond
It is used as a cutting tool because atoms are strongly bonded together.
C
graphite
It is used as an insulator because electrons cannot move.
D
graphite
It is a lubricant because atoms can slide over each other.
